theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_pr_factorial_mul_eq_sum_det
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)) (β : Covector (Euclid P) n) (u : Fin n → Euclid P), (n.factorial : ℝ) * β u = ∑ I : Fin n → Fin P, β (fun a => e (I a)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (e (I b)) (u a))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
